auditor_issues.issue: Nested interactive element inside ARIA button role
auditor_issues.why: FileSlot wraps the drop zone in role='button' with tabIndex={0}, but contains a nested 'Clear' <button>. This violates ARIA HTML structure rules and causes screen readers to misannounce controls.
auditor_issues.fix: Change the outer FileSlot container from role='button' to a group/region div, and attach file input triggers explicitly to an inner trigger button or label.

auditor_issues.issue: Auto-wipe timer lacks pre-wipe confirmation or warning modal
auditor_issues.why: The 10-minute idle privacy session automatically wipes all manuscript text, edits, and findings without an interactive warning modal allowing the user to extend session time.
auditor_issues.fix: Add a pre-wipe dialog trigger at 2 minutes remaining with an 'Extend session' button to prevent unexpected data loss while reading.

auditor_issues.issue: Export menu accessibility missing ARIA keyboard navigation
auditor_issues.why: ExportMenu uses role='menu' and role='menuitem' on drop-down buttons, but lacks standard keyboard arrow key navigation (Up/Down/Home/End) inside the panel.
auditor_issues.fix: Implement arrow key focus management inside ExportMenu or change roles from menu/menuitem to plain collapsible container elements.

auditor_issues.issue: Confusing view snapping on page navigation
auditor_issues.why: jumpToPage in PaperView automatically forces showRevised to false whenever an open finding is selected on that page, surprising users who explicitly enabled Revised view.
auditor_issues.fix: Preserve the user's explicit showRevised toggle state during page jumps instead of implicitly switching text modes.

auditor_issues.issue: Misleading Q1/Q2 quartile branding despite disclaimers
auditor_issues.why: Labeling score cards as 'Q1-like bar' and 'Q2-like bar' creates false authority that conflicts directly with the disclaimer stating it is merely an internal checklist.
auditor_issues.fix: Rename card labels to objective terms like 'High-rigour checklist' and 'Standard checklist' to avoid mimicking commercial journal quartile ranks.

auditor_issues.issue: Batched grammar findings break keyboard list navigation index
auditor_issues.why: When grammarBatched is active in the 'Everything' filter view, individual open grammar findings are omitted from the visible array, causing relative arrow key navigation (j/k) to skip hidden items unpredictably.
auditor_issues.fix: Include batched items in the navigation sequence or clearly lock navigation to the parent summary card.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Lack of Word DOCX export option for revised manuscript
first_time_user_confusions.why: The user edited findings in the app and wants to submit a revised Word draft to their university advisor, but Export only offers a .txt change log or a watermarked PDF.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Add a .docx export option that outputs the revised text with standard manuscript styling.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Strict PDF restriction for similarity and AI reports
first_time_user_confusions.why: The user attempted to upload an HTML or DOCX Turnitin report provided by their university, but the slot rejected it with '.pdf only' without explanation.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Provide clearer slot helper copy noting that Turnitin/iThenticate reports must be printed or saved to PDF before uploading.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: 'LLM humanize' button copy triggers academic integrity fear
first_time_user_confusions.why: Seeing the label 'Draft rewrite (LLM humanize)' makes a PhD student worry that using the feature will violate university rules against AI-generated writing bypasses.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Relabel the button to 'Rephrase span' or 'Academic restatement' to emphasize stylistic clarity over AI evasiveness.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Unclear scope of 'Apply all fixes (N)' button
first_time_user_confusions.why: The student hesitates to click 'Apply all fixes' because it does not state whether it will alter citation markers or rewrite paragraphs automatically.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Add descriptive tooltip/subtext clarifying that 'Apply all fixes' only applies safe, high-confidence grammar and typo corrections.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Confusion between Turnitin percentage and tool findings
first_time_user_confusions.why: The student expected the queue to match their exact Turnitin percentage index directly, but sees categories like 'Common phrase' and 'Methods boilerplate' mixed in.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Add an informational summary header explaining how flagged report matches are grouped into actionable vs. non-actionable academic categories.
